description: This file contains a custom speed test module for Odoo, including classes for counting SQL queries and performing performance analysis on module objects.

classes.name: CounterCursor
classes.description: A cursor wrapper that counts the number of SELECT queries executed.

classes.name: quality_test
classes.description: A class that performs a speed performance test on Odoo module objects, analyzing SQL query counts and demo data.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the class, setting up attributes.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Executes the speed test on specified module objects, measuring query complexity and generating results.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Formats the test results into a table for display.

methods.name: get_result_details
methods.description: Generates detailed HTML report of the test results.
